index.advanced-features-intro: Use the powerful GraalVM JavaScript script system to implement complex automation logic:
index.code-script-example:
// React to different screen colors
mm.on('AfterRecordStopEvent', (event) => {
   let color = mm.getContext().getPixelColor(100, 200);
   if (color.getRed() > 200) {
     mm.log('Red detected, run action A');
   } else {
     mm.log('No red detected, run action B');
   }
});
index.features-callback-subtitle-ext: Listen to application events and implement smart automation:
index.code-event-example:
// Auto-initialize on app launch
mm.on('OnAppLaunchedEvent', (event) => {
   mm.log('App launched, auto-loading config');
});

// Auto-save after recording stops
mm.on('AfterRecordStopEvent', (event) => {
   mm.log('Recording complete, total ' + event.getActions().size() + ' actions');
});
